instruction: Look at task-013_initial.scad. Create a tapered funnel with bolt flange. Overall envelope must be 92 x 92 x 54 mm. The bottom flange outside diameter is 92 mm at z=0, the top outside diameter is 36 mm at z=54, the internal bore tapers from diameter 44 mm at the bottom to 12 mm at the top, and six 6 mm through bolt holes lie on a 68 mm bolt circle through the flange. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-013_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
